method: Manual comparison against public Modrinth project APIs, Modrinth version APIs, and CurseForge project/file pages for similar-name, add-on, and monster-form Verity results surfaced in current SERP sampling. These records explain routing confusion; they are not endorsements, safety verdicts, or mirrors.

projects.name: Verity Dweller
projects.sourceNote: A separate Fabric mob project that adds a fast spawning Verity-style enemy. It is not the same route as Verity JE Project ID on1Y0osD, CurseForge Project ID 1591438, Bedrock Verity BE, or PnTMC.

projects.name: Horrorland - With Verity!
projects.sourceNote: A separate Modrinth modpack route that includes Verity wording in the title. Use it only when the player intentionally wants that modpack profile, not as a replacement for the standalone Verity Mod Java or Bedrock files.

projects.name: Verity
projects.sourceNote: A Paper server management plugin with the same word in the title. It is not the Minecraft horror Verity Mod download, not Verity JE, and not a Bedrock add-on.

projects.name: Verity Body Overhaul
projects.sourceNote: A visual add-on route for Verity JE that replaces the Verity Demon body appearance while keeping the original gameplay, attacks, sounds, and behavior. It requires Minecraft 1.20.1, Forge, and Verity JE, so it is not a replacement for the standalone Verity Mod file.

projects.name: verity.jar
projects.sourceNote: A separate fan project whose source text says it is not associated with the official Verity Team and replaces AI responses with human responses. Treat it as a separate route, not as Verity JE, Verity BE, or PnTMC.

routePolicy: Use /verity-dweller/ when a search result says Verity Dweller, Horrorland with Verity, or a generic Modrinth Verity plugin and the player needs to know whether it is the same as Verity Mod. Use /verity-monster-form/ when the result names Verity Body Overhaul, monster form, Verity May Be, or another route that changes or packages the monster-form experience. Use /download/ for the current standalone Verity JE, Verity BE, PnTMC, and Pocket Edition routes.
